Re: Appeal of Prior Authorization Denial  
Member: Casey Delgado  
Member ID: W200134956  
Reference number: POC-6B51D0A6AA-87439  
Requested service: ACL reconstruction  
CPT: 29888

Dear Member Services Department:

I am appealing the denial of prior authorization for ACL reconstruction, CPT 29888. The denial notice states that the submitted documentation was incomplete and did not permit a medical-necessity determination.

The enclosed records provide the clinical information needed to evaluate this request:

- I have had 14 months of progressive knee pain that has not improved with rest.
- I completed 14 weeks of supervised physical therapy from April 1, 2026, through July 8, 2026, including 24 visits focused on range of motion and quadriceps strengthening. Bracing was also used. These treatments are documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for eight months without adequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on May 9, 2026, provided only three weeks of partial relief.
- An MRI performed on July 5, 2026, showed a complete mid-substance tear of the anterior cruciate ligament with a bone bruise pattern. The menisci were intact, and there was no significant arthritis.
- I have recurrent instability with pivoting and have given way twice on stairs.
- Examination showed positive provocative testing on the affected side, with range of motion limited by pain.
- There is no active infection or untreated substance use. My BMI is 29, and I am a non-smoker.
- Reyes, MD, an orthopedic surgeon, is requesting the ACL reconstruction.

Together, these records document a complete ACL tear, persistent symptoms despite extensive conservative treatment, objective MRI findings, recurrent instability, functional impairment, and examination findings. They also address relevant medical and surgical risk information.

Please conduct a complete reconsideration of the prior authorization request and approve ACL reconstruction under CPT 29888. If the request remains denied, please provide the specific documentation that is considered missing, the exact clinical-review criteria applied to this request, the policy or guideline name and number, the applicable version or effective date, and the clinical reasoning supporting the decision.

The specific CareFirst policy or clinical-review criteria applied to this case has not been publicly provided to me and is not quoted in this appeal. Please include that material with any continued denial so that I can respond to the actual criteria used.

Please confirm receipt of this appeal and send the appeal determination in writing. This appeal is being submitted within 180 days of the August 25, 2026, denial notice and before the stated deadline of February 21, 2027.

Sincerely,

Casey Delgado  
[Mailing address]  
[Telephone number]  
[Email address]

Enclosures:

1. Prior authorization denial notice  
2. MRI report dated July 5, 2026  
3. Physical therapy discharge note documenting 24 visits from April 1, 2026, through July 8, 2026  
4. Medication and treatment history  
5. Orthopedic examination and surgical recommendation from Reyes, MD  
6. Other clinical records supporting the request
